consumes.title: Consumes
consumes.description: Whether the node has input topics at all. Source nodes have none and never hold a queue.

running.title: Running
running.description: Whether the node's consumer group has an active member. Repositioning is refused while it does.

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: Total messages waiting across the node's input partitions.

topic.title: Topic
topic.description: Input topic this partition belongs to.

low.title: Low
low.description: Oldest offset still retained on the broker.

high.title: High
high.description: High watermark: the offset the next produced message gets.

committed.title: Committed
committed.description: Offset the node's consumer group last committed, or null if it never has.

position.title: Position
position.description: Where the node resumes: the committed offset clamped into the retained range.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Messages waiting on this partition (high - position).

partitions.title: Partitions
partitions.description: Per-partition offsets behind the queue depth.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Offset of the message - the value to reposition to in order to process it next.

timestamp.title: Timestamp
timestamp.description: When the message was produced (ISO-8601 UTC), or null if the broker recorded none.

key.title: Key
key.description: Message key, if it has one.

message_id.title: Message Id
message_id.description: message_id header, empty when the producer set none.

correlation_id.title: Correlation Id
correlation_id.description: correlation_id header, empty when the producer set none.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: True if the node has yet to process this message; False for an already-processed one, included so it can be replayed.

preview.title: Preview
preview.description: Start of the payload as text. Null when the caller may not read message content.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: Whether the preview was cut short.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Messages around the node's current position, oldest first.

more.title: More
more.description: Whether messages were left out because the read limit was reached.

previews_visible.title: Previews Visible
previews_visible.description: Whether the caller may read message content. False means every preview is null.
